# HealthFingerprint

HealthFingerprint provides free health and fitness calculators, personalized nutrition planning tools, food nutrition information, and educational articles.

## Main pages

- Home: https://healthfingerprint.com/
- About and editorial approach: https://healthfingerprint.com/about
- Food library: https://healthfingerprint.com/food-library
- Health articles, recipes, and exercise guides: https://healthfingerprint.com/resources
- Contact: https://healthfingerprint.com/contact

## Scope and limitations

Calculators and articles are for general education and planning. They do not diagnose, treat, or replace advice from a qualified healthcare professional. Nutrition values are estimates and may vary by recipe, ingredients, and serving size. For medical decisions, consult a clinician and the primary sources linked in each article.
